bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
bluetooth.body: Insulink connects to your Dexcom G7 over Bluetooth to read your glucose. Without it the app can't find your sensor.

notification.title: Notifications
notification.body: Glucose alarms warn you about highs and lows — even when the app is closed. Allow notifications so you don't miss them.

dnd.title: Critical alarms
dnd.body: Allow Insulink to bypass Do Not Disturb and silent mode, so an urgent low or high still sounds — even when your phone is muted.

activity.title: Activity & steps
activity.body: Allow Insulink to access your motion data to count your steps in the Sport area.

battery.title: Run in background
battery.body: Exempt Insulink from battery optimization so it keeps reading your sensor when the app is closed. Without it Android may stop the connection.

warning.title: Enable silent mode?
warning.body: While silent mode is on you will receive NO alarms — not even for dangerously low or high glucose. A hypo can go unnoticed and become life-threatening. Only enable it if you keep an eye on your levels another way.
